entries.default: Unset means the submission has no runner lease. It is then ordinary work that is not tied to an LSF runner.
entries.effect: In shared mode the daemon records the runner process (id and start time) as the owner of the submission. When that process disappears, the daemon cancels the submission with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after at most 2 seconds.
entries.name: DICE_LSF_LEASE_PID
entries.notes: Internal to the LSF bridge. Do not set it by hand. Both lease names must be present together, and DICE_LSF_RUNNING must be 1. The daemon rejects the submit request when the values are not integers, when the process is not alive with that start time, when it belongs to another user, or when the submitting process does not descend from it (bin/dice:987 to bin/dice:999). The runner sets the pair only after it has read its own start time (bin/dice-lsf-runner:1647). Count for the checker: the literal name is on 6 lines of the 63 files of this area (4 of them in the two test directories).

readers.mechanism: dict lookup in the 'env' field of the submit request (the submitter's forwarded environment), through the constant _LSF_LEASE_PID_ENV

setters.value: the process id of the runner
